title: Find Top 5 Selling Products
description: Product names live in `products`, quantities sold live in `order_items` - you need both. Write a query that returns each product's `product_name` and its `total_quantity` sold (SUM of quantity), for the 5 best-selling products, most sold first.
hints: 💡 SQL concept to consider: JOIN + GROUP BY + ORDER BY + LIMIT together
Join order_items to products on product_id, GROUP BY product_name to get one row per product, SUM(quantity) for the total sold, then ORDER BY that sum descending and LIMIT 5.
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id, grouped by product_name, ordered by the sum descending, limited to 5.
expected_behavior: Returns product_name and total_quantity for the 5 products with the highest total quantity sold, ranked highest first.
solution: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 5;
explanation: This combines four things you already know - JOIN, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT - into one real business question, which is exactly what "top N by some measure" always looks like in practice.
